institution: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

benchmarked_algorithms.selection_criterion: Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation on 4,000 training records, ranked by F1-Score, ROC-AUC, Recall, Precision, Accuracy.

evaluation_context.note: Metrics reflect evaluation on synthetic/augmented project dataset and should not be interpreted as real-world institutional placement prediction accuracy.

feature_importance_methodology.gini_impurity_importance: Calculated natively from Mean Decrease in Impurity across decision tree splits in the Gradient Boosting ensemble. Aggregated back to 9 original features after one-hot encoding.
feature_importance_methodology.permutation_importance: Measures holdout test performance degradation when a specific feature is randomly shuffled. Retained as an independent audited methodology.

probability_and_confidence_semantics.probability_placed: model.predict_proba() output for class 1 (Placed) expressed as percentage (0.0% to 100.0%).
probability_and_confidence_semantics.probability_not_placed: model.predict_proba() output for class 0 (Not Placed) expressed as percentage (0.0% to 100.0%).
probability_and_confidence_semantics.confidence_score: Defined strictly as max(probability_placed, probability_not_placed). Represents the highest class probability returned by the model, not a calibrated statistical confidence interval, Bayesian certainty, or guaranteed job offer.

profile_4_high_backlog.reconciliation_note: Verified directly with frozen pipeline models/best_model.pkl. Earlier 4.76% report placeholder was superseded by verified 43.42% output.

optional_dependencies.purpose: Optional offline training and historical benchmarking experiments. Not required for runtime prediction or terminal application.

model_integrity_verification.notes: No custom transformer class required; standard scikit-learn primitives only. Deserializes cleanly.
